verdict.rationale: Poly ships a built-in agent that works over your own files. It can summarize, explain and edit the file or folder you're viewing (poly-docs-37, poly-docs-31), write new files (poly-docs-27), run multi-step read/search/write tasks (poly-docs-14), and draw on a 'second brain' of memories whose contents are editable and transparent (poly-docs-57, poly-docs-3). The 'clear controls over what data it sees' half is thin: the only control documented is inspecting and editing memories, and the agent is described as seeing whatever you see. missing for 10: explicit data-access or privacy controls scoping what the built-in agent can read, documentation of grounding/citations in answers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
